chunks: "Removing hair from the nose improves the appearance of the face."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣadiq عليه السلام say about removing hair from the nose?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teaches a point of personal cleanliness and beautification. The hadith indicates that removing nasal hair contributes to improving one's facial appearance.
